opportunity.title: Ecomondo Mexico 2027
opportunity.whatIsHappening: Confirmed upcoming: April 20–22, 2027 at Expo Guadalajara, Guadalajara, Jalisco, Mexico. These are activity dates on the organizer’s event page, independently corroborated by the parent event network, not publication dates. Within the requested horizon. Edition numbering is inconsistent: the current About page calls 2027 the fifth edition, whereas the parent network describes the completed edition as fifth and references 2026. Retain the year-based identity; do not rely on the ordinal. No 2028 dates verified.
opportunity.potentialHotelBusiness: Inference using the supplied hotel profile: an Expo-adjacent, 216-room full-service Sheraton is well aligned to visiting exhibitors, international delegations and business attendees needing guestrooms near the exhibition, with possible small briefings or hospitality meetings. City-hotel convenience is more directly aligned than a resort proposition. The organizer’s international-market positioning and existing nearby-hotel programme support the demand mechanism, but do not establish overnight conversion, room nights, meeting bookings or a block suitable for all 216 rooms.
